LanguageData.LP_KarsusEcho.label: echo of Karsus
LanguageData.LP_KarsusEcho.description: An echo the Scroll of Karsus leaves in the mind. Each stack: max neural heat +5%, psychic sensitivity +5%, mental break threshold +2%, up to 10 stacks. Permanent.
LanguageData.LP_NetherilInsight.label: Netherese insight
LanguageData.LP_NetherilInsight.description: Just put down a Netherese scroll, and the incantations of the lost empire still echo in the head: a keener mind, more gained from meditation and study (Intellectual skill learning ×1.25), but neural heat fades more slowly. Lasts 10 hours; once neural heat overflows, the insight dissipates.
